items.query: Which mortgage is meant for someone who expects to pay it off soon after a property sale?
items.answer_text:
The 1-Year Fixed Open mortgage (FX1-O) suits a borrower who expects to repay the mortgage in full or in large part within a short time, such as from the sale of a property [S1].

With FX1-O, you can pay off any amount at any time without a penalty [S4].

Staff may describe these features but may not recommend FX1-O, because the choice depends on the borrower's own plans [S1].
